newsitem.title: USA: Healthcare Financial files for shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Healthcare Financial files for shr offer.

text.p: Healthcare Financial Partners Inc said Monday that it has filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed public offering of 2.63 million shares of its common stock.
Healthcare said that two million shares are being offered by the company.
The underwriters will be granted an option to purchase 394,500 additional shares of common stock to cover over-allotments, if any.
The company said it will use its proceeds to finance anticipated growth of its finance programs and for general corporate purposes, including possible strategic acquisitions and investments.
Montgomery Securities and Lehman Brothers will act as underwriters of the offering.
The company said it anticipates that the proposed sale to the public will begin in May.
